title: The token-keyed private calendar feed answered without a noindex header, so a leaked link could be indexed with its credential in the URL

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 by the scan-seven SEO/GEO finders (26-agent fan-out), confirmed by hand against the tree

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (scan seven, seo-sitemap finder). app/calendar/private/[token]/route.ts served text/calendar with Cache-Control private, no-store and nothing else; robots.ts has no rule for it, and a Disallow would be the wrong tool anyway, because a disallowed URL can still be indexed by reference and a crawler that cannot fetch it never sees a noindex. CLOSED 2026-10-05: the response carries X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync("app/calendar/private/[token]/route.ts","utf8");if(!/X-Robots-Tag.: .noindex/.test(s)){console.error("SCAN-666: the token-keyed private calendar feed answers without X-Robots-Tag: noindex, so a leaked link can be indexed with its credential in the URL.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Fails on main before this change; passes with it.
